1) No overflow on html: overflow-x:hidden on html made some mobile browsers place fixed elements using the old screen height when the address bar hides, so the bar rose
      Horizontal scrolling is now blocked on .mainWrp with clip, which does not affect fixed or sticky elements
   1) No overflow on any parent of the bar: in Chrome on Android, overflow (hidden or clip) on html or on any element that contains the bar
      stops Chrome from moving the bar down when the address bar hides, so the bar stayed raised by the address bar height.
      Horizontal overflow is now clipped only on the blocks next to the bar (ads, main column, footer), never on its parents
.mainWrp{overflow-x:clip}
.secIn>.blogAd,.secIn>.blogM,.secIn>footer{overflow-x:clip}
